title: South Korean Education Minister Resigns Following AI Cheating Scandal
subtitle: The resignation comes after a series of emergency measures were introduced to protect the integrity of the nation's high-stakes college entrance exams.

summary.en: South Korea's Education Minister Choi Kyo-jin has resigned after a major cheating scandal involving artificial intelligence. The controversy began when a top-scoring candidate admitted to using a micro-camera and AI tools to cheat on a tax accountancy exam. This confession caused widespread panic just days before the annual Suneung, the country's crucial college entrance exam. In response, the government introduced strict new rules, including emergency mobile phone alerts and clothing restrictions. President Lee Jae Myung accepted the minister's resignation following public criticism over the government's handling of the situation.
summary.zh: 南韓教育部長崔教振因涉及人工智慧的重大作弊醜聞而辭職。爭議起因於一名獲得高分的考生承認利用微型攝影機與人工智慧工具在稅務會計考試中作弊。這項自白在全國重要的修能考試前幾天引發了廣泛恐慌。為此，政府實施了嚴格的新規定，包括發送手機緊急警報及限制服裝。在公眾對政府處理方式提出批評後，總統李在明接受了部長的辭呈。

paragraphs.en: South Korea’s Education Minister, Choi Kyo-jin, has officially resigned from his position following a national scandal involving cheating with artificial intelligence (AI). The controversy emerged just days before the Suneung, the annual college entrance exam that is vital for the future of millions of students in South Korea. The minister stated that he took full responsibility for the confusion caused by the government's last-minute efforts to prevent similar cheating during the exam.
paragraphs.zh: 南韓教育部長崔教振（Choi Kyo-jin）在爆發一起涉及人工智慧（AI）作弊的全國性醜聞後，已正式辭去職務。這場爭議發生在南韓大學修學能力測驗（簡稱修能）的前幾天，這項年度入學考試對南韓數百萬學生的未來至關重要。部長表示，他對政府在考前最後一刻才採取防範類似作弊行為的措施所引發的混亂，負起全責。

paragraphs.en: The situation began to unfold one week before the Suneung when a man who achieved the top score on a national tax accountancy exam admitted to cheating. The 34-year-old explained in a video message that he used a tiny camera to photograph test questions, sent them to an AI system, and then received the answers on his smartphone. According to The Guardian, the man admitted that his high score was not the result of his own hard work. This confession shocked the public and put immense pressure on the government to ensure the Suneung remained fair.
paragraphs.zh: 事件始於修能考試前一週，當時一名在全國稅務會計師考試中獲得最高分的男子承認作弊。這名三十四歲的男子在一段影片訊息中解釋，他利用微型攝影機拍攝考題，將題目傳送至人工智慧系統，隨後在智慧型手機上接收答案。根據衛報（The Guardian）報導，該男子承認他的高分並非源於自身努力。這項自白震驚了社會大眾，並使政府面臨確保修能考試公平性的巨大壓力。

paragraphs.en: The Suneung is a major event in South Korea. It is a long test that can take up to nine hours to complete. Because the results often decide which university a student can attend, the exam is seen as a path to better jobs and social success. The country takes the exam so seriously that officials usually reschedule aircraft flights and stop military exercises to ensure silence during the test. According to The Guardian, the government even opens the stock market an hour late on the day of the exam to help traffic flow smoothly.
paragraphs.zh: 修能考試是南韓的一大盛事。這是一場耗時長達九小時的馬拉松式考試。由於考試結果通常決定學生能進入哪所大學，因此這場考試被視為通往更好工作與社會成就的途徑。南韓對此考試極為重視，官員通常會調整航班時間並暫停軍事演習，以確保考試期間的寧靜。根據衛報報導，政府甚至在考試當天將股市開盤時間延後一小時，以協助交通順暢。

paragraphs.en: Following the cheating confession, the education ministry acted quickly to introduce new, strict rules. BBC News reports that authorities sent emergency alerts to every mobile phone in the country on the day of the exam, even causing phones on silent mode to make noise. Other measures included banning students from bringing their own erasers, as these could hide digital devices. Students were also told to avoid wearing clothes with buttons, as these could hide tiny cameras. If students did not follow these rules, officials placed stickers over their buttons. Additionally, the government promised a reward of at least $75,000 for anyone who reported cheating or misconduct.
paragraphs.zh: 在作弊自白事件後，教育部迅速採取行動，實施了嚴格的新規定。英國廣播公司新聞網（BBC News）報導，當局在考試當天向全國每支手機發送緊急警報，甚至導致處於靜音模式的手機也會發出聲響。其他措施包括禁止學生攜帶自己的橡皮擦，因為這些物品可能隱藏數位裝置。學生也被告知避免穿著有鈕扣的衣服，以免藏匿微型攝影機。若學生未遵守規定，官員會在其鈕扣上貼上貼紙。此外，政府承諾提供至少七萬五千美元的獎金，獎勵舉報作弊或違規行為的民眾。

paragraphs.en: Despite these efforts, the government faced significant criticism. Teachers' unions argued that the response was too slow. Furthermore, Minister Choi Kyo-jin faced backlash after he was asked during a parliamentary hearing if he was confident that authorities could catch cheaters. According to The Guardian, the 72-year-old minister replied, “Due to my age, I am not confident I could.” This comment caused further anger among the public. Choi did not appear at press conferences in the days leading up to the exam, leaving a vice-minister to announce the new safety measures.
paragraphs.zh: 儘管採取了這些努力，政府仍面臨嚴厲批評。教師工會認為政府反應過於遲緩。此外，崔教振在國會聽證會上被問及是否有信心當局能抓到作弊者時，引發了強烈反彈。根據衛報報導，這位七十二歲的部長回答：「由於我的年紀，我沒有信心能做到。」這番言論進一步激怒了公眾。在考前幾天，崔教振未出席記者會，而是由副部長出面宣布新的安全措施。

paragraphs.en: According to BBC News, the education ministry reported that 111 candidates were found with unauthorized smart devices during this year's Suneung, which was taken by about 500,000 students. The stress caused by the new rules affected many honest students. Some high school seniors expressed worry that their normal glasses would be mistaken for smart glasses, leading some to wear contact lenses instead to avoid suspicion.
paragraphs.zh: 根據英國廣播公司新聞網報導，教育部指出，在今年約有五十萬名考生參與的修能考試中，有一百一十一名考生被發現攜帶未經授權的智慧裝置。新規定帶來的壓力影響了許多誠實的學生。一些高中應屆畢業生表示擔心自己的普通眼鏡會被誤認為智慧眼鏡，導致部分學生改戴隱形眼鏡以避免被懷疑。

paragraphs.en: In his resignation message, Choi Kyo-jin wrote on X that he could not escape the criticism that the government failed to prepare in advance. He noted that now that the exam had finished, he felt a deep sense of responsibility. South Korean President Lee Jae Myung, who has been calling for a complete change to the current exam system, accepted the resignation. The scandal has highlighted the intense pressure surrounding South Korea’s education system and the challenges that new technology brings to traditional testing. As the country looks forward, the government will likely face more calls to modernize how it manages these high-stakes exams to prevent future incidents of academic dishonesty.
paragraphs.zh: 崔教振在社群平台 X 的辭職訊息中寫道，他無法逃避政府準備不足的批評。他指出，現在考試已經結束，他感到深切的責任。南韓總統李在明（Lee Jae Myung）一直呼籲對現行考試制度進行徹底改革，他已接受了這份辭呈。這起醜聞凸顯了南韓教育體系面臨的巨大壓力，以及新科技對傳統考試帶來的挑戰。展望未來，政府可能會面臨更多要求將高風險考試管理現代化的呼聲，以防止未來再次發生學術舞弊事件。

keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（展開布料），這裡指事件的發生過程。文中：The situation began to unfold one week before the Suneung when a man who achieved the top score on a national tax accountancy exam admitted to cheating.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A strong and negative reaction by a large number of people.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 強烈的反對或負面反應。
keyTerms.noteZh: 此詞在新聞報導中常出現，指公眾對某決策的不滿。文中：Furthermore, Minister Choi Kyo-jin faced backlash after he was asked during a parliamentary hearing if he was confident that authorities could catch cheaters.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Involving serious risks if things go wrong; very important.
keyTerms.noteZh: 原意指賭博中下注金額高，這裡形容考試對人生影響重大。文中：As the country looks forward, the government will likely face more calls to modernize how it manages these high-stakes exams to prevent future incidents of academic dishonesty.

quiz.question: Which specific measure did the government implement to prevent students from hiding unauthorized technology during the Suneung exam?

options.A: They required all students to wear special uniforms provided by the government.
options.B: They prohibited students from using their own erasers and covered buttons with stickers.
options.C: They banned students from wearing glasses to prevent the use of smart technology.
options.D: They installed metal detectors at the entrance of every testing center.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第四段，政府為了防止學生隱藏數位裝置，明確禁止學生攜帶自己的橡皮擦，並要求學生避免穿著有鈕扣的衣服，若有鈕扣則會被貼上貼紙。選項 A 文中未提及。選項 C 錯誤，文中提到學生因擔心眼鏡被誤認為智慧眼鏡而自願改戴隱形眼鏡，並非政府強制禁止。選項 D 文中並未提到安裝金屬探測器。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the public's perception of Minister Choi Kyo-jin's leadership during the scandal?

options.A: The public felt he was too young to understand the complexities of modern AI cheating.
options.B: The public was satisfied with his quick response to the cheating confession.
options.C: The public lost faith in his ability to effectively manage the exam security.
options.D: The public believed he was unfairly blamed for a problem caused by the students.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據文章第五段，部長在國會聽證會上坦承自己因年齡問題，對抓捕作弊者沒有信心，這番言論引發公眾憤怒，且教師工會批評政府反應太慢。由此可推斷公眾對其領導能力失去信心。選項 A 與文意相反，他是因年齡大而遭質疑。選項 B 錯誤，教師工會與民眾都對政府反應速度感到不滿。選項 D 錯誤，辭職信中提到他承認政府未能事先做好準備，顯示責任在於政府管理不當。

quiz.question: In the context of the final paragraph, what does the phrase 'high-stakes exams' imply?

options.A: Exams that are extremely difficult and require high levels of intelligence.
options.B: Exams that have significant consequences for a student's future and social status.
options.C: Exams that involve expensive fees and high financial costs for the government.
options.D: Exams that are only taken by a small, elite group of students.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在文章第三段提到，Suneung 的結果決定了學生能進入哪所大學，進而影響未來的工作與社會地位，因此這類考試被稱為 'high-stakes'（高風險/關鍵性）。選項 A 雖然考試很難，但 'high-stakes' 強調的是結果的重要性而非難度。選項 C 與經濟成本無關。選項 D 錯誤，文中提到有 50 萬名學生參加，並非少數菁英。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the Suneung scandal?

options.A: The South Korean government successfully eliminated all forms of cheating in the Suneung.
options.B: AI technology has made it impossible for any student to pass the Suneung honestly.
options.C: The scandal reflects the intense pressure of the Korean exam system and the challenges of adapting to new technology.
options.D: Minister Choi Kyo-jin resigned primarily because he was caught cheating on his own tax exam.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。文章最後一段總結了整起事件，指出該醜聞凸顯了韓國教育體系面臨的巨大壓力，以及新科技對傳統考試帶來的管理挑戰。選項 A 錯誤，政府仍面臨批評且抓到 111 名作弊者。選項 B 過於誇大，文中並未說無法誠實考試。選項 D 錯誤，作弊的是一名 34 歲的男子，而非部長本人，部長辭職是因為政府應對醜聞不力。
